description: Run Sleek's design agent to create or edit screens from a plain-language brief. Send the whole request as ONE message, such as 'a food delivery app with onboarding, restaurants, dish detail, cart, tracking, and profile'. The agent plans the screens together, so separate calls produce mismatched screens. A run uses workspace credits only when it completes or saves changes. By default this waits for the run to finish. If it returns 'queued' or 'running', poll get_design_run. Only one run can be active per project. On CONFLICT, poll get_design_run until the run settles, then retry. cancel_design_run stops it sooner. If a failed run has data.error.url, relay data.error.message to your user with that link. They have to act before you retry. On completion, share projectUrl with your user and call screenshot.

idempotencyKey.description: Pick a unique key for each new design request, such as a UUID. Reuse it for retries to return the original run instead of starting a second one.

imageUrls.description: HTTPS image URLs for visual input, such as screenshots, logos, or style references.

message.description: The full design brief, as one message. Name every screen you want in this single request.

projectId.description: Project id from an item's id in list_projects, or data.id in create_project.

referenceId.description: Design reference to imitate, from list_references.

screenId.description: Edit this existing screen instead of creating new ones. Use the screenId from list_components, or from a previous run's data.result.operations (via design or get_design_run). It is not the component id.

wait.description: Wait for the run to finish before returning. The wait is capped at 270 seconds, after which you get status 'running' back and poll get_design_run. Set false to return immediately and poll from the start, which is the better choice if your client times tool calls out sooner than that.

name: design

code.description: Failure reason, such as out_of_credits, cancelled, execution_timeout, execution_failed, or request_message_persist_failed.

limit.description: The plan or credit limit that caused this error.

url.description: Where the caller's user can resolve this error. Relay it to the user.

result.description: Failed runs can include changes saved before failure.

operations.description: Screen creations, screen updates, and theme changes saved by the run.

componentId.description: Use as componentId to fetch HTML or in componentIds to render screenshots.

screenId.description: Id of the screen. Pass it to a later run to edit this screen.
